name: Quotain
long_description: Quotain is AI sales roleplay software for revenue teams. Reps practice the calls they need to win against AI buyers built from your playbook, CRM context, and past calls, from cold calls and discovery to negotiations, buying committees, and screen-share demos. Every session is scored against your methodology, and reps retry the exact moment that slipped. Managers see who is ready and what to coach. Try a free practice call at quotain.com.
one_liner: AI sales roleplay built from your real deals
